description: This file defines the Vtiger_Filter class, which provides an API to work with vtiger CRM Custom View (Filter) objects. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and managing filters associated with crm modules.

classes.name: Vtiger_Filter
classes.description: Class that manages creation, initialization, update, and deletion of custom view filters in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for creating an instance of Vtiger_Filter.

methods.name: __getUniqueId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for this filter instance.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes a filter instance from a value map.

methods.name: __create
methods.description: Creates this filter in the database for a specified module.

methods.name: __delete
methods.description: Deletes this filter record and associated filter data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the filter, either creating or updating as needed.

methods.name: __getColumnValue
methods.description: Returns the column value string used in filter table.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Adds a field to this filter.

methods.name: addRule
methods.description: Adds a filtering rule to this filter.

methods.name: translateComparator
methods.description: Translates a comparator string to its long or short form.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves an existing filter instance by ID or name.

methods.name: getAllForModule
methods.description: Retrieves all filter instances for a given module.

methods.name: deleteForModule
methods.description: Deletes all filters associated with a given module.
